features.name: amount
features.description: Payment amount in rupees.

features.name: amount_zscore_vs_user_30d
features.description: How many standard deviations the amount is above the user's 30-day mean (0 with fewer than 3 past payments; std floored at max(10% of mean, 50); clamped to [-5, 20]).

features.name: amount_to_user_max_ratio
features.description: Amount divided by the user's largest payment in the last 30 days (1 with no history; clamped to [0, 50]).

features.name: amount_to_balance_ratio
features.description: Amount divided by the balance before the payment (clamped to [0, 10]).

features.name: is_new_payee_for_user
features.description: 1 if the user has never completed a payment to this UPI ID.

features.name: payee_age_days
features.description: Days since the payee was first seen on the platform (0 if never seen; capped at 3650).

features.name: payee_distinct_senders_24h
features.description: Distinct other users who paid this payee in the last 24 hours.

features.name: payee_report_count
features.description: Number of user reports filed against this payee.

features.name: user_txn_count_10min
features.description: Payments completed by the user in the previous 10 minutes.

features.name: user_txn_count_1h
features.description: Payments completed by the user in the previous hour.

features.name: same_amount_repeat_count_1h
features.description: Payments by the user to the same payee in the previous hour within 20% of this amount.

features.name: hour_of_day
features.description: Hour of day in IST (0-23).

features.name: hour_deviation_from_user_norm
features.description: Circular distance in hours between this hour and the user's average payment hour (0 with fewer than 3 past payments; 0-12).

features.name: is_night
features.description: 1 if the IST hour is 23:00-05:59.

features.name: account_age_days
features.description: Days since the user account was created.

features.name: is_new_device
features.description: 1 if the device has never been used for a completed payment by this user.

features.name: failed_attempts_15min
features.description: Failed logins and failed recipient verifications in the last 15 minutes.

features.name: ctx_pressure
features.description: Questionnaire: someone called or messaged asking to pay urgently (0 until answered).

features.name: ctx_otp_or_app
features.description: Questionnaire: asked to share an OTP or install an app (0 until answered).

features.name: ctx_unknown_recipient
features.description: Questionnaire: the user does not personally know the recipient (0 until answered).
